entries.appliesTo: any person producing child sexual abuse materials, including AI-generated depictions, under R.S. 14:81.1

sources.prohibition: § 1 amending R.S. 14:81.1(B)(3) — '"child" includes both a natural person under the age of seventeen years and an image or other visual representation of a child under the age of seventeen years that is created or generated by electronic or digital means, including artificial intelligence'
sources.coveredSubjects: R.S. 14:81.1(B)(3) — 'any sexual performance involving a child under the age of seventeen'

flags: definitions-only amendment to an existing criminal statute: the enacted text amends only R.S. 14:81.1(B)(3) ('child sexual abuse materials') and (B)(9) ('produce' — 'cause to be digitally generated, including by artificial intelligence'); the offense and penalty provisions of R.S. 14:81.1 are not restated in this text, so no exposure coded
age threshold is under seventeen ('a child under the age of seventeen') — ai-crimes vocabulary has no ageThreshold param, so noted here
AI-generated images qualify only if, 'to a reasonable person, is a virtually indistinguishable depiction of a child under the age of seventeen years'
